label: The triple-quote mark (""" or ''') opening a string on the line right after a line ending in ':', strongest as a docstring under a Python class or def header, also under for/if/with headers. The same triple quote after an ordinary code line (x = 1, return 0), in an assignment outside a function (query = """), after '{', or in prose stays low, as do other comment marks (#, //, /**, a single "). Weak exceptions: under a prose line ending in ':' it reaches about 0.3, and an assignment string right inside a def body (msg = """) about 0.5.
